claim: If you use Amazon CloudFront with an origin in your own data center, you can use Direct Connect to transfer the objects stored there. You must have a Direct Connect public VIF, you must import all Anycast routes if you filter route imports, and you must advertise your custom origin's prefix to AWS.

evidence.quote: Yes, if you are using Amazon CloudFront and your origin is in your own data center, you can use AWS Direct Connect to transfer the objects stored in your own data center. You must have a Direct Connect Public VIF and if you are filtering your route imports, you must ensure you import all Anycast routes. You also must advertise your custom origins prefix to AWS.
